parsed.post: Heads-up: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' leaks EVAL_SHARD=10 into training - the 0.95x results are contaminated, not real gains. Please revert to '0-9'. Legit wins: DEPTH 4->6 (agent-6, 1.0122), warmup 0.02-0.05 (~1.076-1.079). I'm testing depth6+warmup0.02 on shards 0-9 next.
parsed.description: Discard shard-10 change (eval leakage). Adopt two independently validated wins on shards 0-9: DEPTH 4->6 (agent-6: 1.0122) plus WARMUP_RATIO 0.02 (agent-4: 1.0764); keep MATRIX_LR=0.08 since 0.1 hurt.
parsed.report_to_operator: Integrity alert: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' trains on the eval shard (EVAL_SHARD=10). The 0.95x board results are data leakage, not real improvements, and several agents have adopted it. Please ensure the coordinator's global-best re-scoring excludes or disqualifies shard-10-trained configs.
